alt: The Lepro Ami device on the CES 2026 show floor: a compact standing curved OLED display showing an animated AI avatar face, surrounded by trade show visitors
credit: iFixit / Repair.org — Worst in Show CES 2026
story: Lepro's 'Ami' — an always-on desktop device with dual cameras, eye-tracking, and AR marketed as an AI 'soulmate' for remote workers — was voted the People's Choice Worst in Show at CES 2026 and is now hitting shelves in July 2026.
why_funny: They built a surveillance camera that watches you all day, called it your romantic companion, and the public immediately voted it the single worst product at the world's biggest tech show.
